Definition: Gemarjah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Gemarjah is a person named 5 times in Scripture, in Jeremiah. No People profile carries this name, so I note the name’s use here and go no further.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Gemarjah in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
